meta.title: Save the drawer with no item

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Provide the required event title while leaving the item list empty.
Choose a template so the Items drawer can be opened.
Open the empty Manage Line Items drawer.

args.because: Please add atleast one item to proceed!

steps.note: Try to save without adding any line item and verify Procol refuses with the expected message.
